title: EmittedFiles
description: An emitter's answer, on stdout: files as data, plus the identity mapping from plan checks to the stack-qualified check ids the rendered tests carry. CORE writes the files — that keeps `generate check` idempotency, write-path auditing, and the hand-edit ban in one place, and denies an adapter the ability to scribble outside its targets. Check identity comes from this mapping, never from parsing emitted source.

generated_by.description: Adapter name and version — names the emitter for anyone reading an error that quotes it.

path.description: Consumer-root-relative, '/'-separated, normalized. Core rejects absolute paths and any '..' segment before writing.

checks.description: One entry per plan check: the stack-qualified id its rendered test carries. Core requires exactly the plan's census — an unmapped plan check or an invented one is a contract violation, because this mapping is what the trace map inherits RU links through.
